title: Love the app!
body: It's easy to customise and I love the pre-made templates. If I could ask for anything that would be Apple Watch compability! Thanks in advance. I’ll recommend this app to everyone!
author: NekoNeeSama

title: Great app, notifications too much
body: This app really helped me get routines in place, especially now when working from home. If I could wish for features, it would be more settings for notifications and to be able to turn notifs of for certain tasks. Sometimes the app disturbs me too soon (“30 mins left!”) when I’m in the middle of a long task and disturbs productivity instead of helping it.
author: Pherenika
